g.text: Super-admin private request chats stay out of the subject index.
Direct emergency read resolves the thread by ID with a reason;
report parties are denied even after case closure.
The request-to-chat shortcut rejects privileged roles.
Participant block creation reuses only an active ordinary block;
a report sanction keeps its case link and appeal-only removal.
Privileged actors and nonparticipants cannot create ordinary blocks.
Admin operational support and escalation history/attachments
do not require a private request report assignment.
Mock behavior is a UI contract, not security evidence.
Фабрики — первый адрес поиска endpoint implementation.
N27: CI находит 10 зарегистрированных factories через AST
и проверяет transformResponse у каждого domain endpoint.
Private attachment response keeps JSON MFA errors for baseApi step-up;
successful image response remains a Blob / object URL.
N23: client/owner request screens read cursor pages.
Only requested pages are kept in the screen state;
Counts are marked partial while more pages remain.
Реальный production graph исключает MSW fixtures.
N34: SEO lifecycle живёт выше всех layouts.
Auth SSR и client navigation используют общие copy/noindex;
Admin CSV transport keeps 403 JSON error codes intact
for the shared MFA step-up dialog; 200 remains a Blob.
N33: parsing/timeout/5xx и SyntaxError не выводят
raw response в UI. Локализованное сообщение и retry
сохраняют понятный сценарий при сбое API.
При смене пользователя или заявки дочерний компонент
монтируется заново: черновик, retry key, offer, cursor,
preview и открытые действия не переходят к другому адресату.
URL date/time имеет приоритет над черновиком.
Сохранённый slot восстанавливается на исходную дату;
исчезнувший slot требует нового выбора до отправки.
Request page aborts pending create/attachment mutations
when navigation, logout or context switch unmounts it.
Late FileReader completion cannot start an attachment.
Route id masks a stale cached provider profile; submitted
request, step and summary state belong to one context only.
Shared legacy draft keys are discarded, never restored.
Account or context switch remounts each form; pending
provider creation/media and fleet vehicle create are aborted on unmount.
A late local file read cannot start an upload or create.
auth / refresh / CSRF / MFA step-up / errors
